claims.claim: Cleanly used Electric bike for sale
claims.evidence: Witness photos show a black/silver motor scooter outdoors, but do not confirm it is electric (no battery pack, controller, or charging port shown).
No battery label/spec, battery compartment, or charging setup is shown/readable in the photos.
No receipt/date, registration, or odometer/mileage evidence is shown.
Photos do not show brake operation or gear/CVT performance; no wear indicators are clearly measurable.
Photos show the scooter body, but rust presence/absence on hidden areas (frame underside, fasteners) is not confirmable from the provided angles.
No part numbers, service records, or close-ups of components are provided to verify originality.

risks.risk: It may not be electric (could be a petrol scooter or electric conversion), which changes value and running cost assumptions.
risks.proof: A clear photo/clip of the battery compartment with visible battery label/spec (72V/20Ah) and the charging port/charger connected.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used scooter with unknown powertrain; treat as not proven electric.

risks.risk: Battery health may be poor (lead-acid capacity loss), affecting range and whether it will hold charge.
risks.proof: A video clip showing the scooter starting/operating plus a battery voltage/capacity test reading (or charger display) after charging.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working/low-range battery risk (worst case for lead-acid).

risks.risk: Brakes may look fine but could be worn or weak; witness photos don’t confirm brake responsiveness.
risks.proof: A short clip of a safe test: front and rear brake application showing stopping power and no pulling/squeal.
risks.if_unproven: Price with brake service risk (assume pads/shoes may need replacement).

risks.risk: Tyres may be worn/cracked even if the scooter looks intact; tyre condition strongly affects safety and cost.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of both tyres (tread depth, sidewall cracks) and wheel spin for wobble.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming tyres may need replacement.

risks.risk: Electricals may have faults (indicators, horn, lights, charging system), which can be expensive to fix.
risks.proof: A clip turning on: headlight/dip, indicators, horn, brake light, and showing charging light/charging progress.
risks.if_unproven: Price as electricals unverified (worst case: some lights/charging not working).

risks.risk: Hidden body/frame damage or misalignment (not visible in the provided angles) could indicate accidents.
risks.proof: Walk-around photos from multiple angles including underbody/frame joints and steering alignment check.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possible hidden damage (worst case).

risks.risk: Ownership/document risk (stolen/encumbered) can make the purchase risky regardless of condition.
risks.proof: Photos of receipt, registration/ID documents, and any serial/engine/battery numbers matching paperwork.
risks.if_unproven: Price as documents not provided (worst case: treat as higher risk).

proof_requests: Show the battery compartment and a clear label/photo of the battery rating (72V and 20Ah) plus the charging port and charger.
Provide a short video of the scooter starting and running (idle, acceleration, and smooth stop).
Show a brake test clip (front and rear) demonstrating stopping power and no pulling.
Provide close-up photos of tyre tread and sidewalls (front and rear).
Show electricals working: headlight (including dip), tail/brake light, indicators, horn, and charging indicator/charging progress.
Provide photos of any serial numbers/identification and receipts/registration documents.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a scooter visually, but key details that determine the correct price (electric specs/battery health, whether it runs well, and brake/electrical condition) are not verifiable from the photos. Without those proof points, any worst-case pricing would be unreliable.
